about: Cities the district job (tools/city-districts/run.js) can build. bbox: [west, south, east, north] with a margin. adm1Match: the province or region name in geoBoundaries ADM1 whose districts (ADM2) make up the city. osmArea: the ISO 3166-2 code of the city's area in OpenStreetMap. worldpop.alias and worldpop.entry are chosen after a discover run and recorded here, so every build reads the same product.
